id: Sourdough Bread Baking Workshop-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Sourdough Bread Baking Workshop
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Mangaroa Farms for a Sourdough Bread Baking Workshop with Doris Zuur, who has been baking the slow way for decades: rye sourdoughs raised on a living starter, wholemeal loaves that rise through an afternoon, Swiss Zopf plaited by hand, focaccia, and a fermented buckwheat loaf for those who can't take wheat. Her bread is the kind that fills a house with its smell and a table with quiet conversation.

Spend an afternoon with her in our kitchen. You'll mix, knead, plait and bake alongside her. You'll learn how to keep a starter alive, how to read a dough by touch, and the small decisions — temperature, time, a bit of gusto — that turn flour and water into a good loaf.

You'll leave with:

A jar of living starter to take home
A warm loaf from the oven
Doris's full recipe collection (rye sourdough, wholemeal, Swiss Zopf, fermented buckwheat, focaccia, Oaties)
Her "0800 bread helpline" for when you need a hand at home

Afternoon tea included. Bring a clean glass jar with a lid, an apron, and a willingness to slow down.

Good bread likes it slow.

We will begin at Sat 7th November | 10:00am at Wharekai - 298 Whitemans Valley Road

Any questions, please email events@mangaroa.org

id: Pick Your Own Veges-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Pick Your Own Veges
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Mangaroa Farms for Pick Your Own Veges at our market gardens. Experience the joy of harvesting your own fresh, spray-free produce straight from the soil.

Signups are per family/group. If you're coming with your family, please just register for 1 ticket.

Choose from four available slots:
9:00AM -9:30AM or
9:30AM - 10AM
10AM - 10:30AM
10:30AM - 11AM

Make a morning of it with your whānau. Meet our gardeners, explore our market garden, permaculture orchard and multispecies maze. Connect with how your kai is grown and enjoy the satisfaction of harvesting your own vegetables.

Available produce:
Carrots: $2/kg
Pumpkins: $4 each

Please bring:
- Your own bags
- Secateurs or knife
- Hat, water, waterproof shoes, warm layers and sun protection

Pick - Weigh - Pay
Pay in cash or Eftpos

Our Farm Shop & Coffee Cart will be open for snacks, hot drinks and extra kai to take home.

We will begin at Sat 3 Oct | 9:00am at 98 Whitemans Valley Road (Farm Shop). Any questions, please email events@mangaroa.org

id: Somatic Breathwork Journey-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Somatic Breathwork Journey
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Amy Webber and Mangaroa Farms for a journey into your breath.

Somatic Breathwork™ is a full embodiment experience designed to help you release stress, trauma, emotions and stuck energy from the body. This is a modality that utilizes your own breath to help shed the layers of yourself that no longer serve, making room for you to call in what will help facilitate change within your life.

Somatic Breathwork™ uses a consciously connected breath pattern to help you tap into your body's innate inner intelligence and find the areas that need clearing. Coupling the breath with immersive music may result in different forms of cathartic emotional releases such as laughing, moving, crying, yelling, and shaking. All forms of expression are encouraged as it allows the body to move any pent up energy and create space for the second half of the breathwork journey.

A gentler breathing technique is used in the second half of the session to help you connect with who you truly are. Together we can use the breath to call in how you want to show up in the world, the changes you want to make, and allow you to see clearly what it would be like to live your best life.

Join Amy Webber and Mangaroa Farms for this immersive journey into your mind and heart. Any questions, please email amy@mangaroa.org
